svg.title: Technology matrix
svg.desc: 60 technologies across 7 layers, 14 of them shipped in live products. LANGUAGES: Java, JavaScript, TypeScript (live), PHP, Python, C, C++, SQL. INTERFACE LAYER: HTML5, CSS3, React (live), Angular, Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS (live), Vite (live), Three.js (live), Leaflet (live), PWA (live), JavaFX. LOGIC ENGINE: Node.js, Express, GraphQL, Apollo, Socket.io, Laravel, Spring Boot, WordPress. DATA MEMORY: MySQL, MongoDB, Mongoose, Supabase (live), IndexedDB · Dexie (live), Zod (live), JPA · Hibernate, JDBC. DELIVERY PIPELINE: Git, GitHub, GitHub Actions (live), Docker, Cloudflare Pages (live), Vitest (live), Playwright (live), JUnit, Postman, Maven. WORKSTATION: VS Code, Visual Studio 2022, IntelliJ IDEA, VirtualBox, Hyper-V, Windows, Linux. AI MODULE: Claude · Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, Gemini, DeepSeek, Copilot, Suno AI, AI agents.
